response.sql: WITH pa AS (SELECT p.player_id, p.bats, AVG(bp.double) AS avg_doubles FROM batting_postseason bp JOIN player p ON p.player_id = bp.player_id GROUP BY p.player_id, p.bats), idx AS (SELECT player_id, bats, avg_doubles, avg_doubles / AVG(avg_doubles) OVER () AS idx FROM pa), d AS (SELECT player_id, bats, avg_doubles, idx, idx - AVG(idx) OVER (PARTITION BY bats) AS idx_minus_hand_avg FROM idx) SELECT player_id, bats, avg_doubles, idx, idx_minus_hand_avg FROM d WHERE bats IS NOT NULL ORDER BY idx_minus_hand_avg DESC NULLS LAST, player_id LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Only players with at least one postseason batting record are included (inner join). Players whose doubles values are all NULL have a NULL average, which the overall and hand averages skip, and they sort last.

The overall average is the mean of per-player averages over all players, including those with NULL bats. The hand average is the mean of the per-player indexes within the same bats value, with the empty string as its own group.
Ties in the difference are broken by player_id, which the request does not specify.
